arguments.content:
"""Underline all headlines in quarterly_report.docx.

A headline is a paragraph whose text is entirely uppercase (containing at
least one letter). For each such paragraph we add <w:u w:val="single"/> to the
run properties, which is the OOXML way of underlining text.

The script edits the document in place (via a temp file + atomic replace) and
prints a summary of which headlines were underlined.
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import zipfile

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
TMP = "quarterly_report.tmp.docx"
BAK = "quarterly_report.backup.docx"

W_P = re.compile(r"<w:p>(.*?)</w:p>", re.S)
W_T = re.compile(r"<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>", re.S)
TAG = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")

U = '<w:u w:val="single"/>'


def is_headline(pblock):
    """True if the paragraph's visible text is all uppercase."""
    full = "".join(W_T.findall(pblock))
    plain = TAG.sub("", full).strip()
    if not plain or not any(c.isalpha() for c in plain):
        return False
    return plain == plain.upper()


def transform(xml):
    underlined = []

    def repl(m):
        block = m.group(1)
        if is_headline(block):
            text = TAG.sub("", "".join(W_T.findall(block))).strip()
            if U not in block:
                block = block.replace("</w:rPr>", U + "</w:rPr>", 1)
            underlined.append(text)
        return "<w:p>" + block + "</w:p>"

    new_xml = W_P.sub(repl, xml)
    return new_xml, underlined


def main():
    shutil.copy2(SRC, BAK)  # safety copy, removed after successful verification

    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
        infos = zin.infolist()
        contents = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in infos}

    xml = contents["word/document.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    new_xml, underlined = transform(xml)
    contents["word/document.xml"] = new_xml.encode("utf-8")

    with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, "w") as zout:
        for info in infos:
            zout.writestr(info, contents[info.filename])

    # Verify: reopen the temp file and count underlined runs.
    with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP) as zout:
        check = zout.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
    count = check.count(U)
    assert count == len(underlined), (count, len(underlined))
    assert len(underlined) == 7, underlined

    os.replace(TMP, SRC)
    os.remove(BAK)
    print("Underlined %d headlines: %s" % (len(underlined), ", ".join(underlined)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
